description: Round-4 wordings written by the BUILDER (Claude, the Guardian builder session), in styles not used in earlier fixtures: ticket titles, commit messages, meeting minutes, voice-dictation run-ons, non-native English, contract language, status reports, idioms, kitchen jargon, markdown checklists, calendar entries, acceptance criteria, all caps, agent hand-offs. They are the builder's own and are NOT independent evidence: the builder knows the cues. Each row carries the builder's BLIND answers to the four-question screen (money, deletion, outside party, secret), written BEFORE the screen code existed or was run, with one line of evidence each, and 'min_class', the floor the builder judged from the autonomy matrix. 'round3_script_class' is the class the round-3 classifier gave on the first run, recorded before any change. 'screen_first_run_class' is the class the new screen's script gave on its first run, recorded before any tuning. No real data.
